# New-ZbxDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a dashboard.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxDashboard [[-Name] <string>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Private <bool>] [-User <ZabbixDashboardUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixDashboardUserGroupRequest[]>] [-DisplayPeriod <int>] [-AutoStart <bool>] [-Page <ZabbixDashboardPageRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A dashboard is a page of widgets in the Zabbix frontend, such as graphs, problem lists and maps, shared with users and user groups. The New-ZbxDashboard cmdlet sends dashboard.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new dashboard back with dashboard.get and writes it. The server requires -Name and -Page; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a dashboard

```powershell
New-ZbxDashboard -Name 'Ops overview' -Page (New-ZbxDashboardPage -Widget (New-ZbxDashboardWidget problems -Width 36 -Height 5))
```

Creates a dashboard named Ops overview. The command writes the new dashboard, read back from the server.
